observed_problem: RETROSPECTIVE_PERIOD is declared as a first-class Research Profile with BOUNDED_PERIOD semantics, but ChatGPT has no simple canonical v2 helper equivalent to Weekly/Thematic initialization. A future month/half/year/custom retrospective would require reconstructing deterministic dates/paths/profile fields by hand or falling back to legacy bootstrap knowledge.
expected_behavior: Provide a small generic Period bootstrap/profile helper that converts an explicit bounded-period specification into a schema-valid Production Profile/State and points ChatGPT to the applicable period guide. The helper exists for efficiency and consistency; it does not encode period-specific editorial judgment.
actual_behavior: scripts/survey_period_v2.py now resolves configured monthly/half-year/annual periods and arbitrary bounded custom specs into the generic RETROSPECTIVE_PERIOD/LONGFORM_SPECIAL Profile, supports side-effect-free plan/resume semantics, and points the agent to the applicable period guide.

provenance.human_review_reference: User premise correction and ChatGPT-first pre-approval re-audit, 2026-08-22

improvement_action: Implemented by WU-012E with a lightweight generic bounded-Period planner/initializer; research/editorial decisions remain ChatGPT-owned.
